purpose: Teach: 泣ける/競っ/上っ/臨む/抜粋/シーツ/出迎え/ハプニング

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママ、昨日泣ける映画見たわ
lines.en: Sho, your mom watched such a tearful movie yesterday.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle smile in the voice. Sharing a small moment from her day naturally, like she's inviting him into her world.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達と競ってかけっこしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I had a race with my friend today.
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Open-mouthed excitement on the first word. Speaking quickly, eager to share before she moves on. Small-child directness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、職位を上ったらしいわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father got a promotion.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact delivery. A slight lift of pride in her voice but contained — this is news worth noting. Quiet confidence in how she shares it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、テストに臨む覚悟だよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm ready to try my best on the test.
lines.style: Determined but soft-voiced. Chin up in the posture. Not boasting — actually committing to it out loud. The small seriousness of a six-year-old taking himself seriously.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新聞の抜粋を集めるの、お父さんの趣味よ
lines.en: Sho, collecting newspaper clippings is your father's hobby.
lines.style: Informative and gentle. Explaining something quietly, as if she's helping him understand Dad a little better. Warm undertone — no judgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくのお布団のシーツ、可愛い柄だね
lines.en: Mom, my futon sheets have such a cute pattern, don't they.
lines.style: Soft, observant. He's noticing something small and sharing it like a private discovery. Ends on a slight lift — genuinely wanting her to notice too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの出迎え、お願いね
lines.en: Sho, would you greet Dad when he comes home?
lines.style: Gentle request wrapped in warmth. Not commanding — asking him to be part of something that matters. Expectant but not urgent.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、運動会でハプニングあったよ
lines.en: Mom, something funny happened at the sports day.
lines.style: Bright, animated bursts. Words coming quickly with genuine excitement. Open and unguarded — he can't wait to tell her. No filter, pure child joy.
